name: Prayers of Taal
source: Ostlanders pp.47 (PDF p.8); cross-checked with Horned Hunters p.5
notes: Work like the Prayers of Sigmar, but the Priest of Taal never wears armour. Roll D6. Horned Hunters version matches Ostlanders except Tanglefoot exempts friendly Zealots (Ostlanders: Ostlander Jaeger) and Earthshudder also removes the building from the board; the Ostlanders text is followed except where noted per spell. Judgement call: Initiative tests in Earthshudder left as written.

spells.name: Stag's Leap
spells.text: The Priest may immediately move anywhere within 9", including into base contact with the enemy, counting as charging and gaining +2 Strength in his first round of attacks. If he engages a fleeing enemy he scores one automatic hit at +2 Strength in the close combat phase and the opponent will flee again (if he survives).

spells.name: Blessed Ale
spells.text: Heal any one model within 2" of the Priest (including himself) to its full Wounds. Any living enemy models (not Undead or Possessed) within 2" of the Priest lose 1 Attack during the next round of combat.

spells.name: Bear's Paw
spells.text: The Priest or a single friendly model within 6" gains +4 Strength until the Priest's next turn.

spells.name: Earthshudder
spells.text: Cast on a single building within 4". Enemy models touching the building suffer a single S6 hit. The building collapses and any models on it count as having fallen to the ground (e.g. a 5" fall: pass two Initiative tests to avoid D3 S10 hits). Horned Hunters version also removes the terrain feature from the board for the rest of the game.

spells.name: Tanglefoot
spells.text: All models (friend and foe) within 12" of the Priest, except friendly Ostlander Jaegers (Horned Hunters: Zealots), can only move at 1/2 speed until the next Shooting phase.

spells.name: Summon Squirrels
spells.text: One enemy within 12" of the Priest suffers 2D6 Strength 2 hits. No armour saves.
